explication: Spec Kit is a Python CLI that bootstraps and customizes projects for agent-assisted Spec-Driven Development. The principal workflow is: a developer invokes `specify init`, the CLI scaffolds project assets, configures an AI-agent integration, installs shared infrastructure, and leaves a project ready for agent skills and workflows. Subsequent commands manage workflows, extensions, presets, bundles, artifacts, and integration hooks. The graph reflects README capabilities and sampled runtime code; unsampled extension payload details are represented only at their supported manager boundary.
